crossRefs.note: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill…
All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all…
But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…
Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,
who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by…
because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them…

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

translations.web: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.
translations.bsb: And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, He said, “Go up and possess the land that I have given you.” But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.
translations.kjv: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
translations.asv: And when Jehovah sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of Jehovah your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
